data.title: Zephyra Residences
data.about:
Zephyra Residences, soon to rise on Dubai Islands, Deira, promises to shine like a gem with its architectural elegance showcased in stunning structures. The project offers meticulously crafted 3-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and townhouses, designed to reflect modern luxury.

Developed by Arsenal East Real Estate Development, every residence offers breathtaking ocean views through floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies, providing residents with the perfect waterfront living experience. Offering flexible payment plans and high investment potential, it promises to be both a dream home and a sound investment opportunity.

characteristics_module.title: Indulge In an Exclusive Waterfront Community Experience
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Tailored Living Spaces: The development provides a diverse selection of unit options, including apartments, penthouses, and townhouses.
  • Swimming Pool: A breathtaking pool with a seamless horizon effect for luxurious relaxation.
  • Modern Gym: A fully equipped fitness center to support various workout routines.
  • Yoga & Meditation Area: A serene space for mindfulness and physical well-being.
  • Spa & Wellness Center: Offering treatments and therapies to rejuvenate mind and body.
  • Landscaped Gardens: Lush green spaces for family gatherings and outdoor leisure.
  • Cycling & Jogging Tracks: Scenic trails promoting an active, outdoor lifestyle.

location_tile.title: The Perfect Waterfront Escape with Seamless City Access
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Zephyra Residences is ideally located on the prestigious Dubai Islands, offering residents a tranquil waterfront lifestyle with easy access to the city's vibrant hubs. The development is a short drive from Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai World Trade Centre, ensuring seamless connectivity.

Major attractions such as the Dubai Frame and Jumeirah Beach are also within reach, while the Gold Souq Metro Station and Dubai International Airport are easily accessible. This prime location provides residents with the best of both worlds—a peaceful retreat with the convenience of nearby business centers and leisure destinations.

  • Gold Souq Metro Station - 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 20 minutes
  • The Dubai Frame - 22 minutes
  • Dubai World Trade Centre - 24 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai - 24 minutes
